<!doctype html><html><body><script>
function write(v, ord) {
  fetchT(ord, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(v) }, 8000)
    .catch(err => console.error("write failed", err));
}
function render(p, dt) {
  const elap = (p.dElapsedMs == null) ? p.dElapsedMs : p.dElapsedMs + dt;
  return elap;
}
</script></body></html>
